units.zh: 史自遷、固，以迄晉、唐，其為書雄深浩博，讀者未能盡曉。
units.en: From Sima Qian and Ban Gu through the Jin and Tang dynasties, the histories they wrote are vast and profound — so much so that readers cannot fully grasp them on their own.
units.literal: Histories from Sima Qian and Ban Gu down through the Jin and Tang — their books are grand, deep, vast, and abstruse; readers cannot fully comprehend them.

units.zh: 於是裴 、顏師古、李賢、何超、董沖諸儒，訓詁音釋，然後制度、名物、方言、奇字，可以一覽而周知。
units.en: Scholars such as Pei Yin, Yan Shigu, Li Xian, He Chao, and Dong Chong then supplied phonetic and exegetical notes, making it possible to survey institutions, material objects, regional speech, and obscure characters in a single reading and understand them completely.
units.literal: Thereupon Pei Yin, Yan Shigu, Li Xian, He Chao, Dong Chong, and other scholars provided exegetical and phonetic glosses, so that institutions, objects, dialect terms, and unusual characters could be surveyed at a glance and fully understood.

units.en: They have been of immense benefit to later generations of scholars.
units.literal: Their help to later students is great indeed.

units.zh: 遼之初興，與奚、室韋密邇，土俗言語大概近俚。
units.en: When the Liao state first emerged, it lay close to the Xi and Shiwei peoples, and its local customs and language were largely rustic and colloquial.
units.literal: When Liao first arose, it was close to the Xi and Shiwei; local custom and speech were generally near to the vulgar.

units.zh: 至太祖、太宗，奄有朔方，其治雖三用漢法，而先世奇首、遙輦之制尚多存者。
units.en: By the reigns of Emperor Taizu and Emperor Taizong, the Liao had seized the northern frontier. Although their administration repeatedly adopted Chinese law, many institutions of the earlier Qishou and Yaolian eras still survived.
units.literal: By the Taizu and Taizong Emperors, they covered the northern regions; though their governance thrice employed Han law, many institutions of earlier generations — the Qishou and Yaolian systems — still remained.

units.zh: 子孫相繼，亦遵守而不易。
units.en: Their descendants preserved these customs in succession, altering nothing.
units.literal: Successive descendants also preserved them without change.

units.zh: 故史之所載，官制、宮衛、部族、地理，率以國語為之稱號。
units.en: Accordingly, the offices, palace guards, tribal divisions, and place names recorded in the history are for the most part designated in the Khitan state language.
units.literal: Therefore what the history records — official institutions, palace guards, tribal divisions, and geography — generally uses the state language for its designations.

units.zh: 不有注釋以辨之，則世何從而知，後何從而考哉。
units.en: Without explanatory glosses to clarify them, how could the present age understand them, or later generations verify them?
units.literal: Without annotations to distinguish them, how would the age know, and how would posterity investigate?

units.zh: 今即本史三互研究，撰次遼國語解以附其後，庶幾讀者無齟齬之患云。
units.en: We have therefore cross-referenced the three sections of this history and compiled an Explanation of the Liao State Language to append here, so that readers need not stumble over unfamiliar terms.
units.literal: Now, taking this history's three sections for mutual study, we compile and arrange an Explanation of the Liao State Language to append after it, so that readers may be free from the trouble of discord.

units.en: Annals of Emperor Taizu
units.literal: Annals of Taizu

units.zh: 耶律氏、蕭氏 本紀首書太祖姓耶律氏，繼書皇后蕭氏，則有國之初，已分二姓矣。
units.en: Yelü and Xiao: the annals open by giving Taizu's surname as Yelü and the empress's as Xiao — showing that two clans were distinguished from the very founding of the state.
units.literal: Yelü Clan, Xiao Clan — the basic annals first record Taizu surnamed Yelü, then record the empress surnamed Xiao; thus from the founding of the state, two surnames were already divided.

units.zh: 有謂始興之地曰世裏，譯者以世裏為耶律，故國族皆以耶律為姓。
units.en: One account holds that the land where the dynasty arose was called Shili; translators rendered this as Yelü, and the imperial clan accordingly adopted Yelü as its surname.
units.literal: Some say the place of initial rise was called Shili; translators took Shili as Yelü, so the state clan all took Yelü as surname.

units.zh: 有謂述律皇后兄子名蕭翰者，為宣武軍節度使，其妹複為皇后，故後族皆以蕭為姓。
units.en: Another account says that Xiao Han, nephew of Empress Shulü and Military Commissioner of the Xuanwu Army, had a sister who also became empress; the consort clan therefore took the surname Xiao.
units.literal: Some say Empress Shulü's elder brother's son, named Xiao Han, was Military Commissioner of Xuanwu Army; his younger sister again became empress, so the consort clan all took Xiao as surname.

units.zh: 其說與紀不合，故陳大任不取。
units.en: These explanations conflict with the annals, and Chen Daren rejected them.
units.literal: These explanations do not accord with the annals, so Chen Daren did not accept them.

units.zh: 又有言以漢字書者曰耶律、蕭，以契丹字書者曰移剌、石抹，則亦無可考矣。
units.en: Some also say that in Chinese characters the names appear as Yelü and Xiao, while in Khitan script they appear as Yila and Shimo — but this too cannot be substantiated.
units.literal: There is also a saying that written in Han characters they are Yelü and Xiao, written in Khitan script they are Yila and Shimo — but this too cannot be verified.

units.en: Xialaiyi Shilie: the name of a district.
units.literal: Xialaiyi Shilie — a district name.

units.zh: 諸宮下皆有石烈，設官治之。
units.en: Every palace district had its shilie subdivisions, each overseen by appointed officials.
units.literal: Under each palace there are shilie; officials are established to administer them.

units.en: Mili: a sub-district, smaller than a full district.
units.literal: Mili — a smaller subdivision of a district.

units.zh: 撻馬狘沙里 撻馬，人從也。
units.en: Tama and Shali: tama means personal attendants.
units.literal: Tama, Shali — tama means personal attendants.

units.en: Shali denotes a young nobleman or attendant lord.
units.literal: Shali means young lord.

units.en: An official charged with supervising the people.
units.literal: An office that supervises and leads the multitude.

units.en: Later the title was shortened to tama alone.
units.literal: Later there were those called only tama.

units.zh: 大迭烈府 即迭剌部之府也。
units.en: Great Dielie Prefecture: the administrative seat of the Diela tribe.
units.literal: Great Dielie Prefecture — that is, the prefecture of the Diela tribe.

units.zh: 初，阻午可汗與其弟撒裏本領之，及太祖以部夷離 即位，因強大難制，析為二院。
units.en: Originally Khan Zuwu and his brother Saben jointly governed it. When Taizu acceded as tribal yilij, the tribe had grown so powerful that it was split into two courts.
units.literal: At first, Khan Zuwu and his younger brother Saben jointly led it; when Taizu acceded as tribal yilij, because it was strong and hard to control, it was divided into two courts.

units.en: The characters lie and la are phonetically similar.
units.literal: Lie and la sound close to each other.

units.zh: 夷離菫 統軍馬大官。
units.en: Yilijin: a senior official commanding troops and horses.
units.literal: Yilijin — a great official commanding troops and horses.

units.en: At the opening of the Huitong era, the title was changed to Great King.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Huitong era, it was changed to Great King.

units.en: Jihui Guo: a place name with two pronunciations, wo and tuo.
units.literal: Jihui Guo — two pronunciations, wo and tuo.

units.en: A place name.
units.literal: A place name.

units.zh: 阿主沙里 阿主，父祖稱。
units.en: Azhu Shali: azhu is an honorific for one's father or grandfather.
units.literal: Azhu Shali — azhu is a title for father and grandfather.

units.en: Tiyin: an official in charge of clan affairs.
units.literal: Tiyin — an office managing clan relations.

units.en: Equivalent to the Chinese office of Director of the Imperial Clan.
units.literal: That is, the duty of the Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.en: Xi and Xi: the second term is pronounced xi.
units.literal: Xi and Xi — the latter is pronounced xi.

units.en: The name of a state.
units.literal: A state name.

units.en: Land belonging to the Central Capital.
units.literal: The territory of the Central Capital.

units.en: Heichezi: a tribal state.
units.literal: Heichezi — a state.

units.en: So named because its people were skilled at making carts and tents.
units.literal: Named for skill in making carts and tents.

units.zh: 契丹之先，嘗遣人往學之。
units.en: The Khitan ancestors once sent envoys to learn these crafts from them.
units.literal: The Khitan forebears once sent people to go and learn from them.

units.en: Yuyue: a high honorific office with no defined administrative function.
units.literal: Yuyue — a noble office with no specific duties.

units.zh: 其位居北、南大王上，非有大功德者不授。
units.en: Its rank exceeded that of the Northern and Southern Great Kings, and was granted only to men of exceptional merit.
units.literal: Its rank stands above the Northern and Southern Great Kings; it is not conferred except on those of great merit and virtue.

units.en: Eagle Army: the eagle is a fierce bird of prey;
units.literal: Eagle Army — eagle is a fierce bird;

units.en: naming an army after it conveys the idea of speed and agility.
units.literal: using it to name the army takes the meaning of swiftness.

units.zh: 後記龍軍、虎軍、鐵鷂軍者，仿此。
units.en: Later references to the Dragon Army, Tiger Army, and Iron Harrier Army follow the same principle.
units.literal: Later records of Dragon Army, Tiger Army, and Iron Harrier Army follow this pattern.

units.en: <Note 1>
units.literal: <One>

units.en: Nianggai: the first character is pronounced wan.
units.literal: Nianggai — the upper character is pronounced wan.

units.en: A place name.
units.literal: A place name.

units.zh: 西樓 遼有四樓：在上京者曰西樓；
units.en: Western Tower: the Liao had four towers; the one at the Supreme Capital was the Western Tower;
units.literal: Western Tower — Liao had four towers: at the Supreme Capital was called Western Tower;

units.en: Mount Muye was the Southern Tower;
units.literal: Mount Muye was called Southern Tower;

units.en: Longhua Prefecture was the Eastern Tower;
units.literal: Longhua Prefecture was called Eastern Tower;

units.en: Tang Prefecture was the Northern Tower.
units.literal: Tang Prefecture was called Northern Tower.

units.en: The emperors hunted seasonally, moving among the four towers.
units.literal: Seasonal hunting excursions were always conducted among the four towers.

units.zh: 阿點夷離的 阿點，貴稱。
units.en: Adian Yilide: adian is an honorific form of address.
units.literal: Adian Yilide — adian is an honorific title.

units.en: Yilide denotes the wife of a high minister.
units.literal: Yilide is the title for a great minister's wife.

units.en: Jiuxia: jiu is the name of a military unit.
units.literal: Jiuxia — jiu is an army name.

units.en: Xia conveys the meaning of command and restraint.
units.literal: Xia means the sense of control and restraint.

units.zh: 夷離畢 即三知政事，後置夷離畢院以掌刑政。
units.en: Yilibi: equivalent to one of the Three Directors of Affairs; later a Yilibi Court was created to oversee criminal justice.
units.literal: Yilibi — that is, one of the Three Directors of Affairs; later the Yilibi Court was established to manage criminal administration.

units.zh: 宋刁約使遼有詩雲「押宴夷離畢」，知其為執政官也。
units.en: The Song envoy Diao Yue wrote in a poem on his mission to Liao, 'presiding at the banquet, the Yilibi' — showing that this was a chief ministerial office.
units.literal: Song envoy Diao Yue, on mission to Liao, had a poem saying 'presiding over the banquet, Yilibi' — knowing thereby that it was a chief minister.

units.zh: 射鬼箭 凡帝親征，服介胄，祭諸先帝，出則取死囚一人，置所向之方，亂矢射之，名射鬼箭，以祓不祥。
units.en: Shooting Ghost Arrows: when the emperor led a campaign in person, clad in armor, he first sacrificed to his ancestors. On departure he took a condemned prisoner, placed him in the direction of march, and riddled him with arrows — a rite called Shooting Ghost Arrows, intended to ward off misfortune.
units.literal: Shooting Ghost Arrows — whenever the emperor personally campaigned, wearing armor, he sacrificed to the former emperors; upon departure he took one condemned prisoner, placed him in the direction of advance, and shot him with a volley of arrows — called Shooting Ghost Arrows, to expel ill omens.

units.en: On the return march, captives were shot instead.
units.literal: Upon returning the army, they then shot captives.

units.en: Later the practice was incorporated into penal law.
units.literal: Later it came to serve as an instrument of penal law.

units.en: Baoli: the name of a villain.
units.literal: Baoli — the name of a wicked man.

units.zh: 大、小鵠軍 二室韋軍號也。
units.en: Great and Small Goose Armies: designations of two Shiwei military units.
units.literal: Great and Small Goose Armies — two Shiwei army designations.

units.en: Divine standard: carried by attendants.
units.literal: Divine standard — carried by attendants.

units.zh: 以旄牛尾為之，纓槍屬也。
units.en: Made from yak tails, it belongs to the category of tasseled spears.
units.literal: Made of yak-tail, belonging to the tassel-spear category.

units.zh: 龍眉宮 太祖取天梯、蒙國、別魯三山之勢於葦澱，射金齪箭以識之，名龍眉宮。
units.en: Dragon Eyebrow Palace: Taizu selected a site at a reed marsh where three mountains — Tianti, Mengguo, and Bielu — converged, marked it by shooting a golden cuo arrow, and named it Dragon Eyebrow Palace.
units.literal: Dragon Eyebrow Palace — Taizu took the terrain formed by the three mountains Tianti, Mengguo, and Bielu at the reed marsh, shot a golden cuo arrow to mark it, and named it Dragon Eyebrow Palace.

units.zh: 神冊三年，築都城於其地，臨潢府是也。
units.en: In the third year of the Sence era, a capital was built there — present-day Linhuang Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third year of Sence, a capital city was built on that site — this is Linhuang Prefecture.

units.en: Cuo, pronounced with the ce initial and jiao final: the name of an arrow type.
units.literal: Cuo — ce angle cut; the name of an arrow.

units.en: Xiaoli: the name of a Shiwei tribe.
units.literal: Xiaoli — a Shiwei tribal division name.

units.zh: 君基太一神 福神名。
units.en: Lord Foundation Great Unity Spirit: the name of a god of good fortune.
units.literal: Lord Foundation Great Unity Spirit — the name of a fortune deity.

units.zh: 其神所臨之國，君能建極，孚於上下，則治化升平，民享多福。
units.en: In the land over which this deity presides, if the ruler upholds the highest standards and earns the trust of high and low alike, the realm enjoys peace and the people receive abundant blessings.
units.literal: In the state where this spirit presides, if the ruler can establish the ultimate standard and win trust above and below, then governance and transformation ascend to peace and the people enjoy abundant fortune.

units.en: Talin: an official title.
units.literal: Talin — an office name.

units.zh: 後二室韋部改為僕射，又名司空。
units.en: Later the two Shiwei divisions were retitled Vice Director, also known as Minister of Works.
units.literal: Later the two Shiwei divisions were changed to Vice Director, also called Minister of Works.

units.zh: 舍利 契丹豪民耍裹頭巾者，納牛駝十頭，馬百疋，乃給官名曰舍利。
units.en: Sheli: wealthy Khitan men who wore wrapped headcloths could purchase the title by contributing ten oxen or camels and a hundred horses.
units.literal: Sheli — Khitan magnates who sported wrapped headcloths, upon paying ten oxen and camels and a hundred horses, were granted an office called sheli.

units.zh: 後遂為諸帳官，以郎君系之。
units.en: It later became a tent-office title, paired with the rank of young lord.
units.literal: Later it became an office of the various tents, linked with the title of young lord.

units.en: Aluduo Li, also known as Aludun.
units.literal: Aluduo Li — also called Aludun.

units.en: An honorific of high distinction.
units.literal: A noble and eminent name.

units.zh: 遼於越官兼此者，惟曷魯耳。
units.en: Of all Liao yuyue officials who also held this title, only Helu did so.
units.literal: Among Liao yuyue officials who also held this, only Helu.

units.en: Xuandi: the chief prison administrator.
units.literal: Xuandi — chief prison official.

units.en: Changgun: an official title.
units.literal: Changgun — an office name.

units.en: Responsible for Yaolian tribal household registers and related affairs;
units.literal: In charge of Yaolian tribal household registers and related matters;

units.zh: 奚六部常袞掌奚之族屬。
units.en: the Changgun of the Six Xi Divisions oversaw Xi clan affairs.
units.literal: the Changgun of the Six Xi Divisions managed Xi clan relations.

units.en: Yinzhuan: the name of the ruler of Bohai.
units.literal: Yinzhuan — the name of the ruler of Bohai.

units.en: Ke Shilu: ke is an official title.
units.literal: Ke Shilu — ke is an office name.

units.en: Shilu is a person's name.
units.literal: Shilu is a personal name.

units.en: Later titles such as Ke Lang and Ke Taishen follow the same pattern.
units.literal: Later Ke Lang and Ke Taishen follow this pattern.

units.zh: 烏魯古、阿里只 太祖及述律后受諲譔降時所乘二馬名也，因賜諲譔夫婦以為名。
units.en: Ulugu and Alizhi: names of two horses ridden by Taizu and Empress Shulü when accepting Yinzhuan's surrender; they were bestowed on Yinzhuan and his wife.
units.literal: Ulugu and Alizhi — the names of two horses ridden when Taizu and Empress Shulü received Yinzhuan's surrender; they were bestowed on Yinzhuan and his wife as names.

units.en: Jiangan: the second character is pronounced gan.
units.literal: Jiangan — gan is the pronunciation of the second character.

units.en: The dwelling place of the Husun Xi.
units.literal: Where Husun Xi dwelt.

units.en: Chai Ce: the name of a ritual.
units.literal: Chai Ce — the name of a ritual.

units.en: Firewood was piled to form an altar, and the emperor received jade memorials from his ministers.
units.literal: Piling firewood to make an altar, receiving jade tablets from the ministers.

units.en: When the ceremony ended, a fire was lit to sacrifice to Heaven.
units.literal: When the rite was complete, firewood was burned to sacrifice to Heaven.

units.en: Established by Khan Zuwu.
units.literal: Instituted by Khan Zuwu.

units.zh: 遙輦氏九帳 遙輦九可汗宮分。
units.en: Nine Tents of the Yaolian Clan: the palace households of the nine Yaolian khans.
units.literal: Nine Tents of the Yaolian Clan — the palace divisions of the nine Yaolian khans.

units.zh: 北剋、南剋 掌軍官名，猶漢南北軍之職。
units.en: Northern Ke and Southern Ke: military command titles, analogous to the Han Northern and Southern Armies.
units.literal: Northern Ke, Southern Ke — army-commanding office names, like the Han duties of the Northern and Southern Armies.

units.zh: 祭麃鹿神 遼俗好射麃鹿，每出獵，必祭其神以祈多獲。
units.en: Sacrifice to the Roe-Deer and Deer Spirits: the Liao people favored hunting roe deer and deer, and each hunt began with sacrifices for a large catch.
units.literal: Sacrifice to the roe-deer and deer spirits — Liao custom favored hunting roe deer and deer; whenever they went hunting, they sacrificed to the spirits to pray for a large catch.

units.zh: 林牙 掌文翰官，時稱為學士。
units.en: Linya: an official in charge of documents, commonly called an Academician.
units.literal: Linya — an office managing documents; at the time called Academician.

units.en: Those attached to the Pasturage Offices handled records only.
units.literal: Those established at the Pasturage Offices only managed ledgers.

units.zh: 瑟瑟禮 祈雨射柳之儀，遙輦蘇可汗制。
units.en: Sese Rite: a rain-prayer ceremony involving willow-shooting, established by Yaolian Khan Su.
units.literal: Sese Rite — the ceremony of praying for rain and shooting willow branches; instituted by Yaolian Khan Su.

units.zh: 再生禮 國俗，每十二年一次，行始生之禮，名曰再生。
units.en: Rebirth Rite: a national custom performed every twelve years, a ceremony of symbolic rebirth called Rebirth.
units.literal: Rebirth Rite — a state custom, once every twelve years performing the rite of initial birth, called Rebirth.

units.zh: 惟帝與太后、太子及夷離得行之。
units.en: Only the emperor, empress dowager, crown prince, and yilij could perform the rite.
units.literal: Only the emperor, empress dowager, crown prince, and yilij were permitted to perform it.

units.en: It was also known as Covering Birth.
units.literal: Also called Covering Birth.

units.zh: 神速姑 宗室人名，能知蛇語。
units.en: Shensu Gu: a member of the imperial clan who could interpret snake language.
units.literal: Shensu Gu — an imperial clan personal name, able to understand snake speech.

units.en: Puge Jiang: the second character is pronounced with the nai initial and ding final.
units.literal: Puge Jiang — the lower character uses the nai ding cut.

units.en: The name of a princess.
units.literal: A princess's name.

units.zh: 三剋統軍官，猶云三帥也。
units.en: San Ke: a military commander, equivalent to Three Commanders.
units.literal: San Ke — army-commanding official, like saying Three Commanders.

units.zh: 詳穩 諸官府監治長官。
units.en: Xiangwen: the chief supervisory official of government offices.
units.literal: Xiangwen — supervising chief of the various government offices.

units.zh: 梯裏已 諸部下官也，後升司徒。
units.en: Tiliyi: a subordinate official; later elevated to Minister of Education.
units.literal: Tiliyi — an official under the various divisions; later promoted to Minister of Education.

units.zh: 達剌幹 縣官也，後升副使。
units.en: Dala Gan: a county-level official, later promoted to Vice Commissioner.
units.literal: Dala Gan — a county official; later promoted to Vice Commissioner.

units.zh: 麻都不 縣官之佐也，後升為令。
units.en: Mabudu: deputy county official, later promoted to magistrate.
units.literal: Mabudu — assistant to the county official; later promoted to magistrate.

units.zh: 馬步 未詳何官，以達剌幹升為之。
units.en: Mabu: an office of uncertain function, attained by promotion from dala gan.
units.literal: Mabu — office unclear; promoted from dala gan.

units.en: Yashu: an official title.
units.literal: Yashu — an office name.

units.en: Possibly yashu, an office of the shilie.
units.literal: Suspected to be yashu, a shilie office.

units.zh: 世燭 遙輦帳侍中之官。
units.en: Shizhu: an attendant-in-waiting of the Yaolian tent.
units.literal: Shizhu — an office of attendant-in-waiting in the Yaolian tent.

units.zh: 敞史 官府之佐吏也。
units.en: Changshi: a deputy clerk in a government office.
units.literal: Changshi — assistant clerk of a government office.

units.zh: 思奴古 官與敞史相近。
units.en: Sinugu: an office similar to changshi.
units.literal: Sinugu — an office close to changshi.

units.zh: 徒睹古 邊徼外小國。
units.en: Tudugu: a small state beyond the border.
units.literal: Tudugu — a small state beyond the frontier.

units.en: Lin: the first character is pronounced dai.
units.literal: Lin — the upper character is pronounced dai.

units.en: A place name: the former Pine Forest region.
units.literal: A place name — the former site of Songlin.

units.zh: 閘撒狘 抹里司官，亦掌宮衞之禁者。
units.en: Zhasayue: an official of the Moli Office, also in charge of palace guard restrictions.
units.literal: Zhasayue — an official of the Moli Office, also in charge of palace guard prohibitions.

units.en: Tama: an escort-attendant office.
units.literal: Tama — an office of personal escort.

units.en: Nongwu: the name of a division.
units.literal: Nongwu — a division name.

units.zh: 葉格戲 宋錢僖公家有葉子揭格之戲。
units.en: Yegexi: the Song official Qian Yi's household played the leaf-card game of the same name.
units.literal: Yegexi — the Song official Qian Yi's household had the leaf-card game yegexi.

units.en: Annals of Emperors Jingzong and Shengzong
units.literal: Annals of Jingzong and Shengzong

units.zh: 飛龍使 掌馬官，亦為導騎。
units.en: Feilong Shi: an official in charge of horses, also serving as a vanguard escort.
units.literal: Feilong Shi — an office managing horses, also serving as vanguard escort.

units.zh: 橫帳 德祖族屬號三父房，稱橫帳，宗室之尤貴者。
units.en: Hengzhang: Dezu's clansmen formed the Three Father Houses, called Hengzhang — the most exalted branch of the imperial clan.
units.literal: Hengzhang — Dezu's clansmen were called the Three Father Houses, termed Hengzhang — the most noble of the imperial clan.

units.zh: 著帳 凡世官之家及諸色人，因事籍沒者為著帳戶，官有著帳郎君。
units.en: Zhuzhang: hereditary official families and others whose property was confiscated became registered zhuzhang households, served by zhuzhang attendants.
units.literal: Zhuzhang — all hereditary official families and various persons whose households were confiscated by registry became zhuzhang households; there were zhuzhang young lords.

units.zh: 杓窊印 杓窊，鷙鳥總稱，以為印紐，取疾速之義。
units.en: Shaowa Seal: shaowa is a general term for birds of prey; it was used for seal knobs to suggest speed.
units.literal: Shaowa seal — shaowa is a general term for birds of prey; it was used for seal knobs, taking the meaning of swift speed.

units.zh: 凡調發軍馬則用之，與金魚符、銀牌略同。
units.en: It was used to mobilize troops, similar to the golden fish tally and silver plaque.
units.literal: Whenever armies and horses were mobilized it was used, roughly like the golden fish tally and silver plaque.

units.zh: 國舅帳克 官制有大國舅帳，此則本帳下掌兵之官。
units.en: Guozhang Ke: the bureaucracy included a Great State Uncle Tent; this was its military commander.
units.literal: Guozhang Ke — the official system had a Great State Uncle Tent; this was the military commander under that tent.

units.zh: 拜奧禮 凡納後，即族中選尊者一人當奧而坐，以主其禮，謂之奧姑。
units.en: Bai'ao Li: when receiving a bride, the clan chose an elder to sit in the inner seat and preside — the Ao Gu.
units.literal: Bai'ao Li — whenever a bride was received, the clan selected an elder to sit in the inner seat and preside over the rite, called the Ao Gu.

units.zh: 送後者拜而致敬，故雲拜奧禮。
units.en: Those escorting the bride bowed in homage, hence the name Bai'ao Li.
units.literal: Those escorting the bride bowed in respect, hence called Bai'ao Li.

units.zh: 拜山禮 祀木葉山之儀。
units.en: Baishan Li: the sacrificial rite at Mount Muye.
units.literal: Baishan Li — the ceremony of sacrificing at Mount Muye.

units.en: Changwen: an official under the various tents.
units.literal: Changwen — an office under the various tents.

units.zh: 亦作常袞，蓋字音相近也。
units.en: Also written changgun — the characters are phonetically similar.
units.literal: Also written changgun — the characters sound close.

units.en: Wanyi Xianhe Ye: a place name.
units.literal: Wanyi Xianhe Ye — a place name.

units.en: Originally the Han county of Tuyin, which contained silver mines.
units.literal: Originally Han Tuyin County; it had silver mines.

units.zh: 太祖募民立寨以專采煉，故名陷河冶。
units.en: Taizu recruited settlers to establish a mining colony there, hence the name Sunken River Smeltery.
units.literal: Taizu recruited people to establish a stockade for exclusive mining and smelting, hence the name Xianhe Ye.

units.zh: 合蘇袞 女直別部名，又作曷蘇館。
units.en: Hesugun: a Jurchen sub-tribe, also written Hesuguan.
units.literal: Hesugun — a separate division of the Jurchen; also written Hesuguan.

units.zh: 執手禮 將帥有克敵功，上親執手慰勞；
units.en: Hand-Clasp Rite: when a general defeated the enemy, the emperor clasped his hand in person;
units.literal: Zhishou Li — when a general achieved victory over the enemy, the emperor personally clasped his hand in consolation;

units.zh: 若將在軍，則遣人代行執手禮。
units.en: if the general was still at the front, an envoy performed the rite on the emperor's behalf.
units.literal: if the general was in the field, someone was sent to perform the hand-clasp rite in his stead.

units.en: It expressed the emperor's special favor.
units.literal: The meaning is preferential treatment.

units.en: Azagezhi: an official title.
units.literal: Azagezhi — an office name.

units.zh: 位在樞密使下，蓋墩官也。
units.en: Its rank fell below the Commissioner of Military Affairs; it was essentially a dun-rank office.
units.literal: Its rank was below the Commissioner of Military Affairs; essentially a dun official.

units.zh: 四捷軍 遼以宋降者分立二部：一曰四捷軍，一曰歸聖軍。
units.en: Four Victory Army: surrendered Song troops were divided into two corps — the Four Victory Army and the Return-to-Sagacity Army.
units.literal: Four Victory Army — Liao divided Song surrenderers into two divisions: one called Four Victory Army, one called Return-to-Sagacity Army.

units.zh: 山金司 以陰山產金，置冶采煉，故以名司；
units.en: Shanjin Si: gold was mined in the Yin Mountains and smelted there, giving the bureau its name;
units.literal: Shanjin Si — because the Yin Mountains produced gold, smelteries were established; hence the bureau's name;

units.en: later renamed the Military Command Bureau.
units.literal: later changed to Military Command Bureau.

units.en: Huxia: the second character is pronounced with the bei initial and pan final.
units.literal: Huxia — the lower character uses the bei pan cut.

units.en: Huxia: the second character is pronounced with the bei initial and pan final.
units.literal: Huxia — the lower character uses the bei pan cut.

units.en: A personal name among the Boliba Eight Divisions.
units.literal: A personal name of the Boliba Eight Divisions.

units.zh: 解洗禮 解裝前祓，飲至之義。
units.en: Jiexi Li: a purification rite before doffing armor, equivalent to a victory libation.
units.literal: Jiexi Li — purification before removing armor; the meaning of a victory libation.

units.en: Dulujin: a place name.
units.literal: Dulujin — a place name.

units.en: Officials of the Six Courts wintered there.
units.literal: Six Court officials resided there in autumn and winter.

units.zh: 行十二神纛禮 神纛解見前。
units.en: Rite of the Twelve Divine Standards: divine standard is explained above.
units.literal: Rite of the Twelve Divine Standards — divine standard is explained above.

units.zh: 凡大祭祀、大朝會，以十二纛列諸御前。
units.en: At all great sacrifices and great court assemblies, the twelve standards were arrayed before the imperial seat.
units.literal: At all great sacrifices and great court assemblies, the twelve standards were arrayed before the imperial seat.

units.en: Nansage Bo: a place name.
units.literal: Nansage Bo — a place name.

units.en: Hezhihuli: a place name.
units.literal: Hezhihuli — a place name.

units.en: Tuogulie: a place name.
units.literal: Tuogulie — a place name.

units.en: Heli: a place name.
units.literal: Heli — a place name.

units.en: Talise: a place name.
units.literal: Talise — a place name.

units.en: Talise: a place name.
units.literal: Talise — a place name.

units.zh: 三班院祗候 左、右班並寄班為三班。
units.en: Sanban Yuan Zhihou: the Left Banner, Right Banner, and Attached Banner formed three banners.
units.literal: Sanban Yuan Zhihou — Left and Right Banners together with the Attached Banner made three banners.

units.en: Zhihou: an official title.
units.literal: Zhihou — an office name.

units.zh: 高墩 遼排班圖，有高墩、矮墩、方墩之列。
units.en: Gao Dun: the Liao seating chart distinguished High Dun, Short Dun, and Square Dun rows.
units.literal: Gao Dun — in the Liao seating chart there were rows of High Dun, Short Dun, and Square Dun.

units.zh: 自大丞相至阿札割只，皆墩官也。
units.en: From the Grand Chancellor to Azagezhi, all held dun-rank offices.
units.literal: From Grand Chancellor to Azagezhi, all were dun officials.

units.en: Houliji: a place name.
units.literal: Houliji — a place name.

units.zh: 頭魚宴 上歲時鉤魚，得頭魚，輒置酒張宴，與頭鵝宴同。
units.en: First-Fish Banquet: at the annual ice-fishing, when the first fish was caught, a feast was held — like the First-Goose Banquet.
units.literal: Touyu Banquet — at the year's ice-fishing, when the first fish was caught, wine was set out and a banquet held — the same as the First-Goose Banquet.

units.en: Eshalie: a place name.
units.literal: Eshalie — a place name.

units.en: Oulijin: a place name.
units.literal: Oulijin — a place name.

units.en: Huantaxin Chala: a place name.
units.literal: Huantaxin Chala — a place name.

units.en: Sheliang Army: she means to invite or request.
units.literal: Sheliang Army — she means to invite.

units.en: Nvgudi: a place name.
units.literal: Nvgudi — a place name.

units.en: Luokunsui: a place name.
units.literal: Luokunsui — a place name.

units.en: Alizhendou: a place name.
units.literal: Alizhendou — a place name.

units.zh: 忽兒珊 西域大軍將名。
units.en: Hu'ershan: the name of a great general of the Western Regions.
units.literal: Hu'ershan — name of a great Western Region army general.

units.en: Qi'erman: a place name.
units.literal: Qi'erman — a place name.

units.zh: 虎思斡魯朵 思亦作斯，有力稱。
units.en: Husi Oruduo: si may also be written si; a title meaning 'powerful.'
units.literal: Husi Oruduo — si is also written as si; a title meaning powerful.

units.en: Oruduo: the name of a palace tent.
units.literal: Oruduo — a palace tent name.

units.zh: 葛兒罕 漠北君王稱。
units.en: Ge'erhan: a title for rulers of the northern steppe.
units.literal: Ge'erhan — a title for rulers of the northern deserts.

units.zh: 祭東 國俗，凡祭皆東向，故曰祭東。
units.en: Sacrifice to the East: by national custom all sacrifices face east, hence the name.
units.literal: Ji Dong — a state custom: all sacrifices face east, hence called Sacrifice to the East.

units.en: Dilie Madu: an official in charge of ceremonial affairs.
units.literal: Ji Dong — a state custom: all sacrifices face east, hence called Sacrifice to the East.

units.zh: 旗鼓拽剌 拽剌，官名。
units.en: Dilie Madu: an official in charge of ceremonial affairs.
units.literal: Dilie Madu — an office managing rites.

units.en: Qi Guo Zhua La: zhua la is an official title.
units.literal: Qi Guo Zhua La — zhua la is an office name.

units.en: The army had a Zhua La Bureau;
units.literal: The military system had a Zhua La Bureau;

units.en: Ruo Jie: the name of a miscellaneous seasonal rite.
units.literal: Ruo Jie — the name of a miscellaneous seasonal rite.

units.zh: 九奚首 奚首，營帳名。
units.en: Jie: a term for seasonal festival rites.
units.literal: Jie — a name for seasonal miscellaneous rites.

units.zh: 食羖之次 大行殯出，羣臣以羖羊祭于路，名曰食羖之次。
units.en: Place of Feeding the Ram: when the great funeral procession set out, the assembled ministers sacrificed rams on the road; this was called the Place of Feeding the Ram.
units.literal: Place of Feeding the Ram — when the great funeral procession set out, the assembled ministers sacrificed rams on the road, and this was called the Place of Feeding the Ram.

units.en: Feeding at the Stop: when the emperor's coffin was carried out, ministers sacrificed sheep along the route — the Rite of Feeding at the Stop.
units.literal: Shi Zhi Ci — when the late emperor's coffin was borne out, ministers sacrificed sheep on the road; called the Rite of Feeding at the Stop.

units.zh: 凡出征，以牝牡麃各一祭之曰𥜒，詛敵也。
units.en: Whenever an army set out, a female and male roe deer were each sacrificed; this was called yan, a curse against the enemy.
units.literal: Whenever an army set out, a doe and a buck of the roe-deer kind were each sacrificed; this was called yan, a curse against the enemy.

units.zh: 勘箭 車駕遠歸，閤門使持雄箭，勘箭官持雌箭，比較相合，而後入宮。
units.en: Before every campaign, a male and female animal were sacrificed in a rite called yan, to curse the enemy.
units.literal: Whenever setting out on campaign, one male and one female animal were sacrificed — called yan — to curse the enemy.

units.zh: 檐牀 一人肩任曰檐，兩人以手共舁曰牀。
units.en: Arrow Verification: when the emperor returned from a distant journey, the Gate Commissioner held the male arrow and the Verification Officer the female arrow; they had to match before entry to the palace.
units.literal: Kan Jian — when the imperial carriage returned from afar, the Gate Commissioner held the male arrow and the Kan Jian official held the female arrow; comparing them for a match, only then could one enter the palace.

units.zh: 攢隊 士卒攢簇，各為隊伍。
units.en: Yan and Chuang: one person bearing a load on the shoulder is yan; two people lifting together is chuang.
units.literal: Yan Chuang — one person carrying on the shoulder is called yan; two people lifting together with the hands is called chuang.

units.zh: 方裀、朶殿 凡御宴，官卑，地坐殿中方墩之上；
units.en: Zuan Dui: soldiers gathered in clusters, each forming a unit.
units.literal: Zuan Dui — soldiers clustered together, each forming a company.

units.zh: 其不應升殿，則賜坐左右朶殿。
units.en: Square Dun and Side Halls: at imperial banquets, low-ranking officials sat on square dun in the hall;
units.literal: Fang Dun, Duo Dian — at imperial banquets, officials of low rank sat on the ground on square dun in the hall;

units.en: those not entitled to enter the hall were seated in the side halls to left and right.
units.literal: those not permitted to ascend the hall were granted seats in the left and right duo halls.

units.zh: 正旦日，上於牕間擲米團，得隻數為不利，則燒地拍鼠以禳之。
units.en: Dipai: a field mouse.
units.literal: Dipai — a field mouse name.

units.zh: 廼捏咿唲 正月朔旦也。
units.en: Nainie Yier: New Year's Day.
units.literal: Nainie Yier — New Year's Day.

units.zh: 𢘉里尀 𢘉讀作狎，尀讀作頗。
units.en: Xialipo: the first character is read xia, and po is read po.
units.literal: Xialipo — the first character is read xia, and po is read po.

units.en: Xieli Kai: xie is pronounced xia; kai is pronounced po.
units.literal: Xieli Kai — xie is read as xia, kai is read as po.

units.zh: 六月十八日宴國舅族，亦曰𢘉里尀。
units.en: The feast held for the imperial maternal relatives on the eighteenth day of the sixth month was also called Xialipo.
units.literal: The feast held for the imperial maternal relatives on the eighteenth day of the sixth month was also called Xialipo.

units.zh: 陶里樺 上巳日，射兔之節名。
units.en: On the eighteenth of the sixth month a banquet was held for the state-uncle clan — also called Xieli Kai.
units.literal: On the eighteenth day of the sixth month a banquet was held for the state uncle clan — also called Xieli Kai.

units.zh: 討賽咿唲 重午日也。
units.en: Taosai Yier: the Double Fifth Festival.
units.literal: Taosai Yier — the Double Fifth Festival.

units.zh: 賽伊唲奢 日辰之好也。
units.en: Saiyi'er She: an auspicious day and hour.
units.literal: Saiyi'er She — an auspicious day and hour.

units.en: Saiyi She: an auspicious day and hour.
units.literal: Saiyi She — a favorable day and hour.

units.zh: 必裏遲離 重九日也。
units.en: Bilichi Li: the Double Ninth Festival.
units.literal: Bilichi Li — Double Ninth Day.

units.en: Daila: burning armor.
units.literal: Daila — burning armor.

units.en: Chaowu'erpo: the name of a battle.
units.literal: Chaowu'erpo — the name of a battle.

units.en: Zhuo Zhang: zhuo means to stand;
units.literal: Zhuo Zhang — zhuo means to stand;

units.en: zhang means a felt tent or yurt.
units.literal: zhang means felt tent.

units.en: Treatise on Officials
units.literal: Officials Treatise

units.zh: 石烈辛袞 石烈官之長。
units.en: Shilie Xingun: chief of the shilie office.
units.literal: Shilie Xingun — head of the shilie office.

units.en: Lingwen: an official title.
units.literal: Lingwen — an office name.

units.zh: 彌里馬特 本官名，後陞辛袞。
units.en: Mili Mateben: an official title, later promoted to xingun.
units.literal: Mili Mateben — an office name; later promoted to xingun.

units.zh: 麻普 即麻都不，縣官之副也，初名達剌干。
units.en: Mapu: equivalent to mabudu, deputy county official; originally called dala gan.
units.literal: Mapu — that is, mabudu, deputy to the county official; originally called dala gan.

units.zh: 知聖旨頭子事 掌誥命奏事官。
units.en: Director of Edict Memorials: an official who managed imperial edicts and memorials.
units.literal: Zhi Sheng Zhi Touzi Shi — an office managing edicts and memorials to the throne.

units.zh: 提轄司 諸宮典兵官。
units.en: Tixia Si: the military administration office of the various palaces.
units.literal: Tixia Si — military office of the various palaces.

units.zh: 皮室昉軍制，有南、北、左、右皮室及黃皮室，皆掌精兵。
units.en: Pishi Fang: the army included Southern, Northern, Left, Right, and Yellow Pishi units, all commanding elite forces.
units.literal: Pishi Fang — the military system had Southern, Northern, Left, Right, and Yellow Pishi, all commanding elite troops.

units.en: Ting Fang: equivalent to the Ministry of Works.
units.literal: Ting Fang — that is, the Ministry of Works.

units.en: Meili: an official title held by imperial relatives.
units.literal: Meili — an office name of imperial kin.

units.zh: 述律皇后族有慎思梅里、婆姑梅里，未詳何職。
units.en: Empress Shulü's clan included Shensi Meili and Pogu Meili — their functions are unknown.
units.literal: Empress Shulü's clan had Shensi Meili and Pogu Meili — their duties are unclear.

units.en: Mogu: an official of the Wali Bureau.
units.literal: Mogu — an office of the Wali Bureau.

units.zh: 先離撻覽 奚、渤海等國官名，疑即撻林字訛。
units.en: Xianli Talang: an office of the Xi and Bohai states, possibly a corruption of talin.
units.literal: Xianli Talang — an office name of the Xi, Bohai, and other states; suspected to be a corruption of talin.

units.en: Treatise on Camp Guards
units.literal: Camp Guard Treatise

units.zh: 象吻 黃帝治宮室，陶蚩尤象置棟上，名曰蚩吻。
units.en: Xiangwen: when the Yellow Emperor built palaces, he cast Chiyou's image and set it on the roof ridge — called Chiwen.
units.literal: Xiangwen — when the Yellow Emperor built palaces, he molded the image of Chiyou and placed it on the ridgepole — called Chiwen.

units.zh: 瓦裏 官府名，宮帳、部族皆設之。
units.en: Wali: a government bureau; every palace tent and tribe maintained one.
units.literal: Wali — a government office name; palace tents and tribal divisions all established it.

units.zh: 凡宗室、外戚、大臣犯罪者，家屬沒入於此。
units.en: When imperial clansmen, consort kin, or high ministers were convicted, their families were confiscated and registered here.
units.literal: Whenever members of the imperial clan, consort kin, or great ministers committed crimes, their families were confiscated and enrolled here.

units.en: Moli: a government office name.
units.literal: Moli — a government office name.

units.zh: 閘撒狘 亦抹里官之一。
units.en: Zhasayue: also one of the officials of the Moli Office.
units.literal: Zhasayue — also one of the officials of the Moli Office.

units.zh: 算斡魯朶 算，腹心拽剌也。
units.en: Zhasa: also an office under the moli bureau.
units.literal: Zhasa — also one of the moli offices.

units.en: Suan Oruduo: suan means a trusted inner attendant.
units.literal: Suan Oruduo — suan means trusted inner zhua la.

units.zh: 已下國阿輦至監母，皆斡魯朶名；
units.en: Oruduo: a palace tent.
units.literal: Oruduo — a palace.

units.en: their glosses give the meaning assigned at their founding.
units.literal: their glosses give the meaning of their founding.

units.en: Guo Alian: 'receiving the state.'
units.literal: Guo Alian — receiving the state.

units.en: Duolibe: 'pacifying and settling.'
units.literal: Duolibe — pacifying and settling.

units.en: Yeluban: 'flourishing.'
units.literal: Yeluban — flourishing.

units.zh: 蒲速碗 義與耶魯碗同。
units.en: Pusuban: same meaning as Yeluban.
units.literal: Pusuban — same meaning as Yeluban.

units.en: Nvgu: 'gold.'
units.literal: Nvgu — gold.

units.en: Guwen: 'jade.'
units.literal: Guwen — jade.

units.en: Woduban: 'increase and multiply.'
units.literal: Woduban — increase and multiply.

units.en: Asi: 'broad and generous.'
units.literal: Asi — broad and generous.

units.en: Aluban: 'assisting and supporting.'
units.literal: Aluban — assisting and supporting.

units.en: Desideben: 'filial piety.'
units.literal: Desideben — filial piety.

units.en: Jianmu: 'left behind.'
units.literal: Jianmu — left behind.

units.en: Treatise on Geography
units.literal: Geography Treatise

units.zh: 屬珊 應天皇後從太祖征討，所俘人戶有技藝者置之帳下，<一一>名屬珊，蓋比珊瑚之寶。
units.en: Shushan: Empress Yingtian followed Taizu on campaign; skilled captives were placed in her tent,<Note 11> named Shushan — like the treasure of coral.
units.literal: Shushan — Empress Yingtian followed Taizu on campaign; captives with skills were placed under her tent,<One One> named Shushan — likened to the treasure of coral.

units.zh: 永州 其地居潢河、土河二水之間，故名永州，蓋以字從二、從水也。
units.en: Yong Prefecture: situated between the Huang and Tu Rivers, hence the name — the character combines 'two' and 'water.'
units.literal: Yong Prefecture — its land lay between the Huang and Tu Rivers, hence called Yong Prefecture — the character follows two and water.

units.en: Xie: the first character uses the mu ge cut; the second the hu jie cut.
units.literal: Xie — upper character mu ge cut, lower hu jie cut.

units.en: A Bohai commandery and prefecture name.
units.literal: A Bohai commandery and prefecture name.

units.en: Qielü: both characters in level tone.
units.literal: Qielü — both in level tone.

units.en: A county of Xingzhong Prefecture.
units.literal: A Xingzhong Prefecture county name.

units.en: Xiyang: the first character is pronounced xi.
units.literal: Xiyang — the first character is pronounced xi.

units.en: A marsh of Youzhou; see the Zhou Officer of Regions.
units.literal: A Youzhou marsh name; see the Zhou Officer of Regions,

units.zh: 菑、時 幽州浸名，出同上。
units.en: Zi and Shi: names of marshes in Youzhou, from the same source as above.
units.literal: Zi and Shi — names of marshes in Youzhou, from the same source as above.

units.zh: 墮瑰 門名，遼有墮瑰部。
units.en: Duogui: a gate name; the Liao had a Duogui tribe.
units.literal: Duogui — a gate name; Liao had a Duogui tribe.

units.zh: 野旅寅 野謂星野，旅謂躔次；
units.en: Ye Lü Yin: ye denotes the astral domain, lü the zodiac position;
units.literal: Ye Lü Yin — ye means astral domain, lü means zodiac position;

units.en: yin is the celestial lodge of the branch.
units.literal: yin is the lodge of the branch.

units.zh: 東北之位，燕分析津之所也。
units.en: The northeast — where Yan marks the crossing of the Ji River.
units.literal: The northeastern position — where Yan divides the ferry of the Ji River.

units.en: Jinzao: the second character uses the zu cong cut.
units.literal: Jinzao — the second character uses the zu cong cut.

units.en: A horse-head ornament.
units.literal: A horse-head ornament.

units.en: Guo Xia Ma: a breed of horse.
units.literal: Guo Xia Ma — a horse name.

units.zh: 謂果樹下可乘行者，言其小也。
units.en: Horses small enough to ride beneath fruit trees — meaning they are diminutive.
units.literal: Horses that can be ridden under fruit trees — meaning they are small.

units.zh: 實里薛袞 祭服之冠，行拜山禮則服之。
units.en: Shili Xuegun: the ceremonial crown worn for the mountain-worship rite.
units.literal: Shili Xuegun — the crown of sacrificial dress; worn when performing the Baishan Li.

units.zh: 䩞鞢帶 上他協切，下徒協切。
units.en: Xiedie Belt: the first character uses the ta xie cut, and the second the tu xie cut.
units.literal: Xiedie belt — the first character uses the ta xie cut, and the second the tu xie cut.

units.en: The belt worn by military officials.
units.literal: The belt of military officials.

units.zh: 擀腰 即拄腰，以鵝項、鴨頭為之。
units.en: Ganyao: equivalent to zhuyao, fashioned from goose neck and duck head.
units.literal: Ganyao — that is, zhuyao, made of goose neck and duck head.

units.en: Humu Mou: a type of helmet.
units.literal: Humu Mou — a helmet name.

units.en: Dan: the first character is pronounced dan.
units.literal: Dan — upper character pronounced dan.

units.en: A horse ridden without saddle or bridle is called cha.
units.literal: A horse without saddle or bridle is called cha.

units.en: White tassel: pronounced er.
units.literal: White tassel — pronounced er.

units.en: It was made by netting white heron feathers, and was also a kind of felt.
units.literal: It was made by netting white heron feathers, and was also a kind of felt.

units.en: Zhuo Ma: grooming or currying horses.
units.literal: Zhuo Ma — grooming horses.

units.zh: 欄子軍 居先鋒前二十餘里，偵候敵人動靜。
units.en: Lanzi Army: posted twenty-odd li ahead of the vanguard to reconnoiter enemy movements.
units.literal: Lanzi Army — stationed twenty-odd li ahead of the vanguard, scouting enemy movements.

units.zh: 弓子鋪 遼軍馬頓舍，不設營塹，折木稍為弓，以為團集之所。
units.en: Gongzi Pu: Liao troops on the march did not dig entrenchments; they bent saplings into bow-shapes as rally points.
units.literal: Gongzi Pu — when Liao armies halted, they did not build camps or ditches; they bent wooden poles into bows as gathering places.

units.zh: 又諸國使來，道旁簽置木稍弓，以充欄楯。
units.en: When envoys from various states came, wooden-tipped bows were set up beside the road to serve as railings and shields.
units.literal: Also, when envoys from various states came, wooden-tipped bows were set up beside the road to serve as railings and shields.

units.zh: 云為戶 義即營運，字之訛。
units.en: Yunweihu: the meaning is yingyun; it is a scribal error.
units.literal: Yunweihu — the meaning is yingyun; it is a scribal error.

units.zh: 鐘院 有寃者擊鐘，以達于上，猶怨鼓云。
units.en: Bell Courtyard: those with grievances struck a bell to reach the ruler, like the grievance drum.
units.literal: Bell Courtyard — those with grievances struck a bell to reach the ruler, like the grievance drum.

units.zh: 鐘院 有冤者擊鐘，以達於上，猶怨鼓雲。
units.en: Bell Court: the wronged could strike a bell to reach the emperor — like the grievance drum.
units.literal: Zhong Yuan — if one had a grievance one struck the bell to reach the ruler above — like the drum of complaint.

units.en: Chugu: an official title.
units.literal: Chugu — an office name.

units.en: Responsible for interrogating prisoners in the northern bureau.
units.literal: In charge of interrogating prisoners on the northern side.

units.en: Five Shilie: that is, the Five Courts.
units.literal: Five Shilie — that is, the Five Courts.

units.zh: 非是分院為五，以五石烈為一院也。
units.en: The court was not divided into five parts; five shilie constituted one court.
units.literal: It was not that the court was divided into five; rather five shilie formed one court.

units.en: Liu Zhua: zhua means one hundred.
units.literal: Liu Zhua — zhua means the number one hundred.

units.zh: 遼有六百家奚，後為六院。
units.en: The Liao had the Six-Hundred-Family Xi, which later became the Six Courts.
units.literal: The Liao had the Six-Hundred-Family Xi, which later became the Six Courts.

units.zh: 二院，即迭剌部析之為二者是也。
units.en: Two Courts: the Diela tribe divided into two.
units.literal: Two Courts — that is, the Diela tribe split into two.

units.en: Splitting Elk Hide: the character means a male deer.
units.literal: Splitting elk hide — the character means a male deer.

units.en: Strong enough to tear apart a male deer's hide.
units.literal: Strength enough to split a male deer's hide.

units.zh: 莫弗紇 諸部酋長稱，又雲莫弗賀。
units.en: Mofu He: a title for tribal chiefs; also called Mofu Ho.
units.literal: Mofu He — a title of tribal chieftains; also called Mofu He.

units.en: Ruru: er xuan cut.
units.literal: Ruru — er xuan cut.

units.en: The name of a state.
units.literal: A state name.

units.en: Houjin: a Turkic official title.
units.literal: Houjin — a Turkic office name.

units.zh: 舔鹹鹿 鹿性嗜鹹，灑鹻於地以誘鹿，射之。
units.en: Licking-Salt Deer: deer crave salt; alkaline salt was scattered on the ground to lure them, then they were hunted.
units.literal: Licking-Salt Deer — deer crave salt; alkaline salt was sprinkled on the ground to lure deer, then they were shot.

units.en: Nugui: the name of a gamekeeper.
units.literal: Nugui — the name of a gamekeeper.

units.zh: 可敦 突厥皇后之稱。
units.en: Kedun: the Turkic title for an empress.
units.literal: Kedun — the Turkic title for empress.

units.zh: 忒里蹇 遼皇后之稱。
units.en: Teili Jian: the Liao title for empress.
units.literal: Teili Jian — the Liao title for empress.

units.en: Nouwo Mo: mo is also written gai.
units.literal: Nouwo Mo — mo is also written gai.

units.en: Nouwo: a title for the earth goddess.
units.literal: Nouwo — a title for the earth goddess.

units.en: Mo: a maternal honorific.
units.literal: Mo — a title for mother.

units.zh: 乙室、拔里 國舅帳二族名。
units.en: Yishi and Bali: names of two clans of the imperial maternal relatives' tents.
units.literal: Yishi and Bali — names of two clans of the imperial maternal relatives' tents.

units.zh: 龍錫金佩 太祖從兄鐸骨札以本帳下蛇鳴，命知蛇語者神速姑解之，知蛇謂穴傍樹中有金，往取之，果得金，以為帶，名「龍錫金」。
units.en: Dragon-Given Gold Belt: Taizu's cousin Duoguzha heard a snake cry under his tent and summoned Shensu Gu, who understood snake speech; the snake said gold lay in a tree by its burrow; they retrieved it and fashioned a belt called "Dragon-Given Gold."
units.literal: Dragon-Given Gold Belt — Taizu's cousin Duoguzha heard a snake cry under his tent and summoned Shensu Gu, who understood snake speech; the snake said gold lay in a tree by its burrow; they retrieved it and fashioned a belt called "Dragon-Given Gold."

units.en: Sala: the name of a wine vessel.
units.literal: Sala — a wine vessel name.

units.zh: 遙輦糾 遙輦帳下軍也。
units.en: Yaolian Jiu: a military unit of the Yaolian tent.
units.literal: Yaolian Jiu — an army under the Yaolian tent.

units.zh: 其書永興宮分糾、十二行糾、黃皮室糾者，仿此。
units.en: Units such as Yongxing Palace Division Jiu, Twelve Rows Jiu, and Yellow Pishi Jiu follow the same pattern.
units.literal: Records of Yongxing Palace Division Jiu, Twelve Rows Jiu, and Yellow Pishi Jiu follow this pattern.

units.en: Tuli: an official title.
units.literal: Tuli — an office name.

units.en: Same as the Tuli of the Xi Six Divisions.
units.literal: Same as the Xi Six Divisions Tuli.

units.en: Tu and tu represent corrupted characters.
units.literal: Tu and tu are character corruptions.

units.en: Qindian Xiaodi: an official title.
units.literal: Qindian Xiaodi — an office name.

units.en: The Liao had many xiaodi offices; the remainder are not annotated.
units.literal: The Liao system had many xiaodi offices; the rest are not glossed.

units.zh: 雜丁黃 禮，男幼為黃，四歲為小，十六為中，二十一為丁。
units.en: Za Ding Huang: a ritual classification — boys in infancy are huang; at four, xiao; at sixteen, zhong; at twenty-one, ding.
units.literal: Za Ding Huang — a rite: boys young are huang, four years is xiao, sixteen is zhong, twenty-one is ding.

units.en: In battle, the young and weak were mixed in to deceive the enemy.
units.literal: In the army, the young and weak were mixed in to confuse the enemy.

units.zh: 遙輦剋 遙輦帳下掌兵官。
units.en: Yaonian Ke: the military officer under the Yaonian tent.
units.literal: Yaonian Ke — the military officer under the Yaonian tent.

units.zh: 柢枑 宮衞門外行馬也。
units.en: Dihu: the wooden barriers outside the palace-guard gates.
units.literal: Dihu — the wooden barriers outside the palace-guard gates.

units.zh: 榾柮犀 千歲蛇角，又為篤訥犀。
units.en: Guduo Rhinoceros: the horn of a thousand-year-old snake, also called dunuo rhinoceros.
units.literal: Guduo rhinoceros — the horn of a thousand-year-old snake, also called dunuo rhinoceros.

units.en: Two Strings of Pearls: the second character uses the pu wei cut.
units.literal: Two strings of pearls — the second character uses the pu wei cut.

units.en: Five hundred pearls made one bei.
units.literal: Five hundred pearls make one bei.

units.zh: 題里司徒 題里，官府名。
units.en: Tili Situ: tili is the name of an office.
units.literal: Tili Situ — tili is the name of an office.

units.en: Zhizhong: the first character uses the zhi li cut.
units.literal: Zhizhong — the first character uses the zhi li cut.

units.en: A place name.
units.literal: A place name.

units.en: Tangyin: a gaming throw in bo.
units.literal: Tangyin — a gaming throw in bo.

units.zh: 臨庫 以帛為通曆，具一庫之物，盡數籍之，曰臨庫。
units.en: Lin Ku: a silk register inventory listing every item in a warehouse — called 'facing the storehouse.'
units.literal: Lin Ku — using silk as a general register, listing all items in a storehouse in full count — called lin ku.

units.zh: 堂帖 遼制，宰相凡除拜，行頭子堂帖權差，俟再取旨，<一九>出給告敕。
units.en: Tang Tie: under Liao practice, when a chancellor was appointed or removed, a provisional tang tie with touzi authorization was issued; upon further imperial approval,<Note 19> a formal edict followed.
units.literal: Tang Tie — under the Liao system, whenever a chancellor was appointed or dismissed, a preliminary tang tie with touzi authorization was issued; after receiving further instruction,<One Nine> a formal appointment edict was issued.

units.en: Hence the office of Director of Touzi Affairs.
units.literal: Hence there was the office of Director of Touzi Affairs.

units.en: See the Miscellaneous Records of the Yin Mountains.
units.literal: See the Miscellaneous Records of the Yin Mountains.

units.zh: 夷離菫畫者 畫者人名，為夷離菫官。
units.en: Yilijin Huazhe: Huazhe was a person's name and held the office of Yilijin.
units.literal: Yilijin Huazhe — Huazhe was a person's name and held the office of Yilijin.

units.en: Husi: a title meaning 'powerful.'
units.literal: Husi — a title meaning powerful.

units.en: The annals write 'Husi' — the meaning is identical.
units.literal: The annals say 'Husi' — the meaning is the same.
